zh.title: 阿聯酋航空獲柏林每日航班 270 架 777X 訂單延至 2027 年
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空獲柏林每日航班；270架777X訂單延至2027年；波音777交付大幅減少
body: 阿聯酋航空在經過數十年的爭取後，獲得柏林每日航班權。
其 270 架波音 777X 訂單則面臨延遲、被拒收機身，並預計推遲至 2027 年首飛。
波音在 2026 年第三季交付 161 架商用飛機，前九個月累計 475 架。
同期 777 系列僅交付 5 架，年初至今累計 20 架。
有分析指出，飛機正因 777X 進一步落後而獲得更多青睞，重塑長程市場競爭格局。
波音防務、太空與安全事業部在第三季交付 33 架飛機，前九個月累計 98 架。

en.title: Emirates Secures Daily Berlin Flights as 270 Boeing 777X Orders Slip to 2027 Debut
en.summary: Emirates wins daily Berlin flights; 270 Boeing 777X orders delayed to 2027; 777 programme deliveries drop sharply
body: Emirates has won daily Berlin flights after decades of lobbying.
Its 270 Boeing 777X orders face delays, rejected airframes and a 2027 debut.
Boeing delivered 161 commercial aircraft in Q3 2026 and 475 in the first nine months of the year.
The 777 programme recorded only five deliveries in the quarter and 20 year‑to‑date.
The aircraft is gaining ground as Boeing's 777X slips further behind schedule, reshaping the battle for long‑haul dominance.
Boeing's Defence, Space & Security division delivered 33 aircraft in Q3, bringing its nine‑month total to 98.
